_comment_physics: Long-run dendrite config — moderate undercooling (delta=0.7) for slower growth allowing arm development before saturation. ε=0.15 is strong cubic anisotropy with 4.1x stability margin against Heun CFL on 27pt stencil at dt=0.005.
_comment_grid: 192^3 ≈ 7M points, ~108 MB checkpoint, ~280 MB per .vts. Largest grid that fits 5-hour T4 budget at acceptable disk usage.
_comment_time: max_steps=60000 is the upper bound; the engine will auto-exit cleanly when the dendrite reaches the boundary (typically step 4000-7000 on 192^3) — see exit_on_saturation. AllenCahnKernels.cu:52 returns 0 force at boundary cells, so once phi > saturation_threshold on a wall slab the integrator destabilises within ~100 steps. The guard catches this and writes a final checkpoint + VTK frame.
_comment_output: VTK every 500 steps. With auto-exit at saturation around step 4000-7000, that gives 8-15 frames at ~280 MB each = ~2-4 GB on disk — enough for a smooth 1 fps -> 12 fps stitched animation.
_comment_checkpoint: Checkpoint every 3000 steps (= ~4 minutes of compute lost on crash), keep_last=3 (= ~324 MB on disk). The resume target picks the latest automatically.
